projects.problemStatement: People often struggle to stay accountable to their personal goals and lose motivation without tangible stakes or impartial verification.

projects.title: HomeProof
projects.description: AI-Powered Property Inspection & Risk Assessment Platform
projects.details:
AI-powered property evaluation ecosystem.
Uses YOLOv8 to identify structural anomalies, maintenance requirements, and safety vulnerabilities.
Integrates OpenAI and Gemini for automated property insights.
Generates inspection narratives and remediation plans.
Uses Sarvam AI for multilingual accessibility and voice-driven interactions.
Uses Groq for low-latency inference.
Backend built with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
Supabase used for authentication and secure asset management.
Cross-platform React Native interface.
AI-enhanced documentation and media ingestion.
projects.problemStatement: Traditional property inspections are manual, highly prone to human error, and require extensive time to generate accurate structural and safety reports.
projects.motivation: I aimed to leverage computer vision (YOLOv8) and generative AI to automate the identification of structural anomalies, drastically reducing inspection time and standardizing safety assessments.

projects.title: Sonic Bridge

Binary PCM streaming over WebSockets.
Sub-6-second end-to-end translation.
WebRTC noise suppression.
Voice Activity Detection.
Speaker verification.
1-to-many broadcast architecture.
One speaker can stream translated audio to multiple listeners.
Speech-to-text.
Neural translation.
Streaming text-to-speech.
projects.problemStatement: Language barriers in live lectures and professional sessions severely hinder effective communication and learning for non-native speakers.
projects.motivation: I built this to provide sub-6-second real-time neural translation over WebSockets, ensuring seamless, low-latency cross-lingual communication in 1-to-many broadcast settings.

projects.title: Smart Attendance System
projects.details:

GPS geofencing.
Session-specific QR codes.
JWT authentication.
Bcrypt password encryption.

projects.problemStatement: High-quality, real-time speech-to-text and translation tools are often inaccessible or poorly optimized for South Indian regional languages.
projects.motivation: To build an inclusive, multilingual accessibility tool that empowers users who are not fluent in English to easily communicate and consume spoken content in their native regional languages.
